    Navigation Graph

    A Navigation Graph separates screen flow from the UXML hierarchy. Unity Graph Toolkit stores the editable .uinavgraph; saving validates it and imports a runtime UINavigationAsset used by UINavigatorBehaviour.

    Asset lifecycle

    1. Create Assets > Create > UI Navigation > UI Navigation Graph.
    2. Edit nodes, inspector options, and connections.
    3. Save the graph to validate and rebuild its runtime asset.
    4. Assign the graph to the single active UINavigatorBehaviour.

    Editor tools and generators can also use code-first authoring.

    Nodes

    Node Purpose
    Start Declares the single initial route
    UI Applies View commands and exposes Signal, Toggle, Delay, and View outputs
    Send Signal Collects UI outputs and resolves a matching Signal Portal without rendering
    Portal Defines the global destination route for a Signal or Toggle
    Random Chooses one branch by relative Weight
    Time Scale Sets Time.timeScale and continues an Action chain
    Debug Log Writes a Console message
    Load Scene Starts a Single or Additive scene load
    Set Active Loaded Scene Makes a loaded scene active
    Unload Scene Unloads a scene while protecting the last loaded scene
    Application Quit Quits a build or stops Editor Play Mode

    The Pivot node was removed in 0.4.0. See its migration page.

    Routes and history

    UI outputs normally connect directly to a UI or Action chain. Multiple outputs that should reach one global destination connect to the Multi input of Send Signal; the matching Portal owns the route to the actual UI.

    Portal matching is global and runs before outputs on the active UI node. Push records the previous screen, Replace changes screens without modifying history, and Back executes connected Actions before requesting history navigation.

    Enable Clear History when entering a UI or Send Signal destination should discard both Back and Forward stacks. Enable Use Back on a UI node that may consume a graph Back request.

    Follow Play Mode

    Enable Tools > UI Navigation > Follow Play Mode In Graph to highlight the active runtime node while testing.
